Local Storage Persist Behavior

Local Storage Persist is a Persist behavior that writes committed FeatureCell state to browser localStorage during the Persist stage. It provides durable, origin-scoped persistence suitable for larger state values that must survive page reloads and full browser restarts.

This behavior observes the finalized pipeline output after all upstream processing—including resolve, merge, operators, filters, and reducers—has completed. The received value represents the authoritative, reduced state and is serialized and stored using a feature-scoped, namespaced localStorage key.

Local Storage Persist does not transform values, emit snapshots, or influence pipeline control flow. Its role is limited strictly to persistence and hydration of finalized state in a predictable, fail-safe manner.

Storage Characteristics

Browser localStorage typically provides 5–10 MB of storage per origin, making it suitable for moderately sized application state, cached data, and user preferences. Unlike cookies, stored values are not transmitted with network requests.

When the persisted state is undefined, the associated localStorage entry is removed entirely. When a valid value is present, it is serialized using JSON.stringify and written directly to storage under the FeatureCell’s scoped key.

Execution Semantics

Local Storage Persist executes synchronously within the Persist stage. Storage writes and removals occur inline and complete before the pipeline proceeds. All errors during serialization or storage access are caught and logged without interrupting pipeline execution.

Note

Local Storage persistence is the recommended default for most client-side persistence use cases. It offers substantially more capacity than cookies and is well-suited for durable UI state, cached resources, and user-specific configuration that must survive browser restarts.

Diagrams
Configuration

Local Storage Persist does not accept runtime configuration options. Its behavior is fully defined and deterministic, providing synchronous serialization, storage, and fail-safe execution by default.

Configuration consists solely of attaching or removing the persist behavior from a FeatureCell. When present, the behavior automatically participates in the Persist stage and observes the finalized pipeline output.

When the finalized state value is undefined, the associated localStorage entry is removed automatically. When a value is present, it is serialized using JSON.stringify and written under a feature-scoped, namespaced key.

Local Storage Persist may be freely stacked with other persist behaviors. When multiple persist behaviors are configured, each is invoked sequentially with the same final pipeline value.

Examples

Example 1: Use the Local Storage Persist Behavior in a FeatureCell

This example demonstrates a FeatureCell configured with the withLocalStoragePersistBehavior . When state updates are committed via mergeState, the finalized FeatureCell value is written to localStorage during the Persist stage.

Local Storage Persist observes the fully reduced pipeline output and performs persistence as a side effect. It does not transform values, influence merge semantics, or participate in pipeline control flow.

Note

Persist behaviors operate after all upstream stages—including resolve, merge, operators, filters, and reducers—have completed. Multiple persist behaviors may be attached to a FeatureCell and will be executed sequentially. 

{{`// app.config.ts

export const appConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
  providers: [
    provideVault({ logLevel: 'off' }),

    provideFeatureCell(
      EmployeeService
      {
        key: 'employees',
        initialState: []
      },
      [
        // Attach localStorage-based persistence
        withLocalStoragePersistBehavior
      ]
    )
  ]
};

// bank-employee.service.ts

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { FeatureCell, injectVault } from '@sdux-vault/angular';
import { Employee } from './employee.shape';

@FeatureCell`}}<Employee[]>{{`('employees')
@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class EmployeeService {
  readonly vault = injectVault`}}<Employee[]>{{`(EmployeeService);

  constructor() {
    this.vault.initialize();
  }

  addEmployee(): void {
    // Final state is persisted to localStorage
    this.vault.mergeState({
      value: [{ id: 1, name: 'Jane Doe' }]
    });
  }
}`}}
 
{{`export const employeeCell = FeatureCell`}}<Employee[]>{{`(
  {
    key: 'employees',
    initialState: [],
  },
  [
    // Attach localStorage-based persistence
    withLocalStoragePersistBehavior
  ]
);

// Initialize the FeatureCell
employeeCell.initialize();

// Commit state and persist to localStorage
employeeCell.mergeState({
  value: [{ id: 1, name: 'Jane Doe' }]
});`}}
